scope: Seven exact raster images: six native previews and the HB/SNL comparison. Qualitative structural review with independent panel scales.
findings: Installed and isolated isometrics show two distinct coupling flanges, the relocated external spring and the long hollow sliding collar, with no obvious unintended collision or disconnected joint.

The new axial section follows the catalogue order: rear spring flange aft of the enlarged cardan head, then a forward end-bearing pocket and a separate collar joint. The preserved earlier section exposes the single-flange approximation that required correction.

The joint section shows separate ring and bush material, axial shoulders and the collar lip capturing the stack. The six short screws are seated on the lip with blind receiving holes; the exact section includes two heads and their wire cross-sections.
The collar-hidden view exposes the end ring and internal splines, with six repeated screw heads around the actual joint. The bronze bush is mostly occluded in this view and is assessed in section.

The isolated locking-wire view shows one continuous route passing through all six drilled heads and paired twisted ends between adjacent heads. It is an inferred formed route, not a demonstrated locking design.
The long collar bore is visibly vacant. Main bearing, positive sleeve, keys, cone support and thrust/ball stack remain unbuilt; empty space is not treated as a physical part.

HB and SNL use different marks for the coupling, collar and bearings. Original opposite orientations are retained; panel scales are independent. No matched-scale fit or exact hidden-contour agreement is claimed.
remaining_discrepancies: HB/SNL variant membership and dimensional transfers remain unresolved; axial stations, collar stock, bearing diameters and clearances are estimated.
Wire length is printed as 26 inches, while 1.5 mm diameter is an approximation rather than a verified W.&M. gauge16 conversion; twist count, route and locking strength are unqualified.
The preceding SNL33 callout25 mismatch remains open; spring-clamp hardware follows the written SH849A allocation.
Crankshaft/nut engagement, the internal clutch stack, main cones and operating parts are absent; standard tank integration is pending.
